proposal.notes: nach-cities-countries (0/24), in-enterable-places-countries (1/24), and nach-hause-motion (2/24) are severely under-represented while an-edges-water dominates at 13/24. The two non-load-bearing variants (auf-islands-events, zu-hause-location) are omitted from the pool entirely to keep generation focused on the five constructions that must be covered. Share weights give nach-cities-countries a plurality (3) as the prototypical case while capping an-edges-water at share 1 to break its current dominance.

proposal.notes: The pool is heavily skewed toward -en endings (19/24) while the two -e slots are starved (4 and 1 respectively). A floor of 6 approved exercises per slot forces balanced representation of all three weak-declension contexts without over-constraining the dominant -en-elsewhere variant.

The measured pool is heavily skewed toward weak participles (12/24) while -ieren verbs appear only once. Shares are set so weak and strong each hold a plurality at 3, with the three structurally distinct no-ge-/infix-ge- patterns each at 2, targeting roughly equal representation across all five constructions without letting any single variant dominate.

The intransitive variant was critically under-realized (1/24), so its share is raised to match the transitive variant's weight. The participle-final-position variant is marked non-load-bearing in the data, so it retains a minimal share of 1 to keep it present without distorting the pool.
